title: Malicious code in ep_nxs14622 (npm)
description: The ep_nxs14622 npm package, an Etherpad plugin, contains a hidden unauthenticated HTTP GET route that exposes sensitive host system information such as hostname, username, platform, Node.js version, current working directory, and process ID. This covert endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication and serves no legitimate administrative purpose, effectively creating a reconnaissance backdoor on any Etherpad server where the plugin is installed.
